title: New duties that are germane to an existing office
shortTitle: New duties that are germane to an existing office
summary: Germane duties are responsibilities sufficiently related to an existing office that assigning them does not require a new constitutional appointment.
notes:
Shoemaker permits already commissioned engineering officers to take related park-development responsibilities. Weiss applies the principle to commissioned military officers assigned judicial duties within the military justice system. The inquiry concerns the relationship between the old office and the added functions.

This doctrine also protects the appointments process against circumvention. Congress can define and enlarge an office’s duties, but a purported assignment of unrelated responsibilities to a known incumbent may function as selection for a new office. The assigned cases uphold related duties; they do not authorize Congress to fill any new office by attaching it to a chosen person’s existing job.
